window.stageWindow: Reference acquisition finishes within seven days of its first dispatch. Paired fresh methods finish within72 hours of one another and within seven days of reference acquisition. Violations invalidate promotion under this matched-window design; preserve descriptive results.

definitions.geography: City proper, ordinary visitor-accessible central neighbourhoods; Bandipur is the Nepal settlement, Oaxaca is Oaxaca de Juarez. No distant resorts or country substitutes.
definitions.inexp_meal_1p: One regular non-premium main dish or explicitly complete single-person meal at an ordinary casual sit-down restaurant, excluding starter, dessert, beverage, tips and optional service. Exclude tasting menus, sharing platters, child menus, snacks/sides, hotel fine dining and international fast-food chains. Determine main-course eligibility from menu labelling/description, not price. Enumerate every explicitly eligible regular main/complete meal visible in the selected menu; venue reference is their median. Missing eligibility remains missing.
definitions.coffee: Regular cappuccino without add-ons; median qualifying prices within venue.
definitions.beer: Domestic draft standard serving, retain stated serving size; no bottled substitution or volume conversion. Different known sizes remain separate diagnostic strata; unknown size remains separately labelled.
definitions.cocktail: Standard non-premium cocktail at bar/restaurant; median qualifying items within venue.
definitions.wine_glass: Ordinary wine by glass; median qualifying items within venue, retain size and do not pool mismatched serving bases.
definitions.midrange_meal_2p: Diagnostic only: explicit three-course menu per person doubled, or separately identified starter/main/dessert sections with within-course medians summed and doubled; no drinks. Conditional priced basket, not an observed actual order.
definitions.hotel_3star_2p: Probe one standard room for two adults,17-20 November2026, public non-member rate, independently stated three-star class, excluding breakfast and including evidenced mandatory taxes/fees. Divide complete three-night total by3; explicit nightly quote requires same dates and all charges. Unknown occupancy/date/class/tax means proxy/missing. Retain cancellation terms. No from-rate as matched evidence.
definitions.tax: Primary references include only source-evidenced mandatory charges and exclude optional tips/service. Record explicit inclusion/exclusion, mandatory status, fixed amounts or percentage rates, application base and any order/compounding. Missing information is uncertain-basis diagnostic; contradictory interpretations are genuine disputes. Apply the exact feeNormalization contract; never infer rates,inclusion,order,discounts or exemptions.
definitions.fullBaskets: Not a feasibility requirement or a permitted claim in this revision. No comprehensive street meals, premium meals or guided activities are acquired. Old basket definitions stay archived hypotheses; no production ratios may manufacture reference components.

referenceRules.aggregation: One value per independent venue/measure: median eligible item amounts within venue, then median of distinct-venue values per city/measure. Retain items, venue count, min/max, dated status and selection order. Independently operated venues only; duplicate branches/menus do not increase n. Normalize documented mandatory charges per feeNormalization BEFORE item medians; no city estimate or production multiplier can fill a missing normalization.
referenceRules.primaryEligibility: Observed original public menu with required geography/unit/meal/tax basis; at least3 independent eligible venues for meal measure, and completed review. Retrieved current-undated menus permitted and explicitly labelled. Conditional sampled-offer agreement, not population truth.
referenceRules.reviewSelection: Sampling unit is one provisionally eligible primary meal venue/measure aggregate, not an atomic menu item. Denominator N is all such aggregates across the six cities, including cities that currently have fewer than3 eligible venues. At most one inexpensive_meal_1p aggregate per independently operated selected venue, hence N<=18. Freeze the complete eligible/ineligible/uncertain aggregate ledger and constituent atomic rows before selection. Aggregate ID=CITY_ID/VENUE_RANK/inexp_meal_1p, where rank is the original selected-result rank. Choose ceil(0.20*N) aggregates by ascending SHA256 of UTF-8 restart-1-review|AGGREGATE_ID, lexical ID tie-break. N=0 selects0 and feasibility fails. Do not revise selection after adjudication, replace rejected selections, or remove difficult rows to shrink N. For each selected aggregate independently verify the full menu eligibility, completeness of eligible-main enumeration, every constituent amount/currency and charge normalization, then recompute the aggregate. Preserve atomic rows, but their number does not increase the sampling denominator. All genuine definition disputes are additionally independently reviewed. Reviewer receives no predictions/scores. Review outcomes may change final eligibility; report pre-review N,selected IDs,post-review N and source count.
referenceRules.corrections: Preserve original row, reason, timing and reviewer observed correction. Apply factual corrections uniformly to all methods. Never numerically repair a prediction. Source excerpt allowance at most25 words total per source.
referenceRules.freeze: Before predictions freeze supported cells, missing reasons, normalization, FX, source identities, independent-review outcomes and hashes. All six pilot cities remain in execution and coverage denominator; unsupported cells are unscored, not zeros.
referenceRules.sourceOverlap: Price searches prohibited for baseline/candidate001. Any price lookup invalidates that run. RBA overlap is expected and excluded from price-source overlap. Future sourced candidates need separate same-source and independent-source diagnostics.
referenceRules.reviewBudget: At minimum12 eligible meal aggregates needed for4 cities*3 venues, the random sample is3 aggregates; at maximum18 it is4. Each aggregate must originate from a single collector-opened original menu page/document and one open must expose the menu basis; separate mandatory-basis pages count additional actions and cannot be assumed accessible for free. Random review therefore normally uses3-4 source opens, leaving6-7 of10 for genuine disputes. If menu access or disputes require more than10 total opens, retain unresolved and fail the review gate; no extra acquisition or selective deletion. This is a bounded feasibility test, not a promise all disputes fit. Hotel/drink diagnostic aggregates do not enter primary random-review denominator; mark them unreviewed unless reviewed because of a genuine dispute or sharing a selected source. Never claim20% random coverage of diagnostics or atomic items.
referenceRules.disputeDefinition: A genuine definition dispute is a recorded disagreement between collector/validator/reviewer about applying a frozen rule to available evidence, or contradictory source statements about geography,classification,main-course eligibility,mandatory status,inclusion or fee basis/order. Log disputed aggregate/atomic IDs, competing interpretations and evidence before review; all such disputes require independent adjudication within10 actions, even if the row was initially excluded. Mere absence of tax/inclusion/order information is uncertainty/missing, not a dispute: mark unknown_tax or unknown_fee_basis and exclude from primary without inventing a charge or requiring a verification search. A claimed included tax with no supporting source statement fails deterministic completeness validation and is uncertain, unless someone asserts conflicting evidence; it is not silently accepted. Unknown rows stay in the full collection/missingness ledger but outside N because provisionally ineligible. Reviewer finding missing evidence in a selected aggregate may adjudicate ineligible rather than unresolved; inaccessible source is unresolved. This separation does not waive genuine disputes or the4-city eligibility gate.

feasibility.hypothesis: Fixed-order direct menu sampling yields reviewed three-venue meal references in at least4 of the6 original development cities within40 new retrieval actions. Separate hotel probes test exact-date source access only.
feasibility.menuSelection: Query exactly: {{CITY}} {{COUNTRY}} restaurant cafe menu main course cappuccino draft beer. Record ranked results before opening. Select the first3 distinct potentially eligible original menu URLs in result rank; reject obvious non-city, aggregator-only, chain and hotel-fine-dining identities from displayed identity, not price. Open each once. Blocked/ineligible opens consume their slot; no fourth venue. Search snippets alone cannot establish primary meal rows. Local-language text may be translated offline. Do not prefer old pilot sources.
feasibility.hotelSelection: For Hanoi/Bled/Copenhagen only query exactly: {{CITY}} {{COUNTRY}} 3 star hotel 17 November 2026 20 November 2026 2 adults total taxes. Open first ranked named-property or public booking-provider result showing an exact-date offer or booking entry. No login, checkout, API or paid access. A failed exact-date attempt stays failed. Search order, not price, selects property. One open maximum; no interactive navigation beyond the2-action allocation.
feasibility.reviewOrder: Group frozen selected PRIMARY MEAL AGGREGATES and all genuine disputes by source URL; open source URLs in ascending lexical order. For each sampled aggregate verify every constituent eligible main and the completeness of inclusion against the menu, plus charge basis. Maximum10 actions including any needed basis-page opens; no new venues. Unresolved required review fails feasibility. Mere missing tax/basis rows are documented uncertainty rather than mandatory dispute searches.
feasibility.pass: At least4 of6 fixed cities each have3 independent eligible meal venues, all required random/dispute review completed, and no unresolved basis ambiguity in those primary cells. Hotel success is separately at least1 exact-date matched offer; hotel failure does not block the meal gate. No complete-basket requirement.
feasibility.fail: Stop candidate dispatch under this revision and publish per-city attempts/missing reasons plus hotel access result and insufficient-evidence conclusion. No more searches until pass, no replacement city, no candidate001 attempt/completion counted. Any new acquisition method needs prospective designer revision; this gate remains failed.
feasibility.assessment: One strong-designer assessment call after collection/review; no source lookup or price generation. Only a pass can release the contingent candidate contract.

candidate001.appendix:
Research candidate 001 — inexpensive-meal definition only:
For inexp_meal_1p, estimate the typical price of one regular non-premium main dish or explicitly complete single-person meal at an ordinary casual sit-down restaurant in the stated city area. Exclude starters, desserts, beverages, tips, optional service, tasting menus, sharing platters, child menus, snacks/sides, hotel fine dining and international fast-food chains. When imagining a venue with several qualifying mains, use the middle of those regular main prices rather than its cheapest or premium dish. metrics.expectedDenominator: Every registered repeat crossed with every frozen supported reference cell; failures/timeouts/unreadable/invalid-FX attempts retained. Unsupported references excluded from loss but reported against all6/16/8 cities.
metrics.primary: Valid cell loss=abs(log(predictionUSD/referenceUSD)); invalid/missing prediction=ln(4). Average repeats within measure, measures within category, categories within city, then cities equally. Candidate001 has one primary meal measure/category. Same reference cells across methods, not necessarily equal repeat counts.
metrics.failureGate: Candidate failed-request proportion <=baseline AND no candidate failure at paired repeat1/2 where corresponding baseline succeeds AND supported-cell coverage >=baseline. Baseline repeat3 remains in primary; equal-repeat1/2 sensitivity must retain positive improvement direction.
metrics.regressions: Secondary category with at least3 supported cities: city-macro mean successful-only APE must not increase by more than0.05. Pooled successful-cell p90 APE must not increase more than0.05 on primary and each such category. Absolute successful-cell median signed log-bias must not worsen more than0.05. Linear-interpolated quantiles as core.mjs. Smaller categories descriptive; cannot establish category safety. No full-budget improvement claim.
metrics.uncertainty: Show ln(2)/ln(10) penalties; both must retain positive improvement. Recompute against observed reference min/max and leave-one-venue-out medians. Enumerate joint min/median/max assignments across eligible pilot cities; use10000 seeded assignments at full16. Promising needs positive gain in at least90% of these reference-variation assignments; show worst case and fraction, descriptive not probabilistic. Central10% margin still required. Undated sources remain labelled.

verdicts.reject: Nonpositive direction, material regression or new failure; preserve evidence.
verdicts.inconclusive: Positive gain below10%, uncertainty gate fails or required support absent.
verdicts.invalid: Model/prompt/independence/window/protocol breach; retain resources and executed terminal attempt.
verdicts.supportedImprovement: Full development promising and frozen finalist confirms >=10% relative gain, positive lower95% paired-city CI and all screens, separately by model and measured meal scope.
verdicts.promisingUnconfirmed: Development promising but confirmation positive direction without margin/CI/screen success; no second finalist.
verdicts.noImprovement: Valid comparisons fail to support change; retain v1.1.
verdicts.insufficientEvidence: Reference feasibility/support inadequate; no global accuracy claim.

repairProvenance.reason: Pre-freeze validation: atomic-item sampling can exhaust review actions merely because menus contain many items; mandatory-fee schema omitted explicit percentages and compounding.
repairProvenance.evidence: No new price/source evidence read or generated. Only original draft read; repair is prospective before collection.
repairProvenance.unchanged: Six-city scope,4-of6/3-venue gate,40 actions,cheap-model restrictions,independence,accuracy thresholds and budgets preserved.

feeNormalization.purpose: Normalize directly documented menu/offer amounts to a complete mandatory-charge basis before within-venue medians, currency conversion or scoring. All arithmetic is deterministic offline. Collector records facts, not invented fee corrections.

targetTransactions.inexp_meal_1p: One diner buying exactly one eligible main/complete meal, no other item. A documented mandatory per-bill charge applies once; this one-person anchor convention does not validate a two-person whole budget.
targetTransactions.coffee_beer_cocktail_wine: Diagnostic one adult buying one stated serving in one transaction; require charge applicability to that transaction.
targetTransactions.midrange_meal_2p: Two adults buying the documented two-person three-course basket, no drinks; per-bill fee once, per-person fee twice.
targetTransactions.hotel_3star_2p: One room,two adults,three nights; normalize whole stay, then divide3. Room-night multiplier3,person-night multiplier6,person multiplier2,stay/booking multiplier1.

feeNormalization.listedAmount: Original finite positive numeric quote; preserve original amount field as alias equal to listedAmount. No normalized value overwrites the source quote. Principal P=listedAmount*documented listedQuantityInTarget; menu main quantity1, an exact-date room-night quote quantity3, a full3-night quote quantity1. Do not multiply a per-room quote by adults.
feeNormalization.transaction: {people:positiveInteger,rooms:nonnegativeInteger,nights:nonnegativeInteger,items:[{atomicRowId,quantity:positiveNumber}],listedQuantityInTarget:positiveNumber}; quantities derive solely from the frozen target and documented unit. Ambiguous unit means missing.
feeNormalization.mandatoryChargeStatus: all_included|explicit_additions|unknown. all_included requires an explicit source statement covering mandatory charges. explicit_additions requires an explicit exhaustive basis or statement that the listed additions complete the payable mandatory total; merely seeing one tax does not prove no other fees. Unknown stays diagnostic.

chargeSchema.id: Unique within row; stable menu order. Preserve every explicit mandatory or optional charge; optional excluded from normalization.
chargeSchema.mandatory: true|false|null; null disqualifies matched primary when potentially payable
chargeSchema.includedInListedAmount: true|false|null; true means do not add again, null means incomplete basis
chargeSchema.value: finite nonnegative number directly sourced; no assumed value
chargeSchema.valueUnit: currency_amount|percent|fraction; percentage r=value/100 for percent or r=value for explicitly fractional quote
chargeSchema.currency: Source currency; fixed additions must match principal currency, otherwise normalization missing under this revision
chargeSchema.applicationUnit: per_item|per_person|per_bill|per_room_night|per_person_night|per_stay|percentage_base; must be evidenced and applicable to the target
chargeSchema.baseRefs: For percentage only, nonempty array of principal and/or explicit prior charge IDs. Represents the exact documented taxable/service base, not a guessed order. For fixed charge empty array.
chargeSchema.sourceEvidence: Minimal source statement establishing value,mandatory status,inclusion and applicability, shared25-word/source excerpt allowance plus document location/section metadata
chargeSchema.orderEvidence: Source statement establishing base/compounding/order, or explicit independent percentages of listed principal; unknown if not stated
chargeSchema.rounding: null or {stage:charge,decimalPlaces:nonnegativeInteger,mode:half_up|floor|ceiling}; only use when explicitly documented, otherwise retain unrounded deterministic arithmetic

arithmetic: Compute principal P from original quoted amount and documented unit. For a multi-item dinner P=sum normalized listed quantities BEFORE transaction-level additions; never charge per-bill amounts once per course.

For each explicit mandatory fixed fee excluded from listed amount, delta=value*target quantity for its evidenced applicationUnit: item count,people,1 bill,rooms*nights,people*nights,or1 stay. Per-item applicability to particular items must be documented; otherwise missing.

For each explicit mandatory percentage excluded from listed amount, compute delta=r*(sum of explicitly named baseRefs). principal refers to P; charge IDs refer to their computed delta. The dependency graph must be acyclic and source-evidenced. Same-base independent percentages all reference principal and do not compound; compound percentage may reference principal and a prior fee only when the source states that basis. A textual list of two percentages without base/order does NOT establish either form.

Included charges contribute no additional delta and are never extracted/re-added. This revision does not support a percentage base that requires separately extracting any included tax/fee component; such normalization is missing even if a component is mentioned, unless the source directly states the complete payable total for the target transaction. Do not back-solve an included component. Charge IDs in baseRefs therefore refer only to excluded mandatory charge deltas; reject any included-charge reference.

Payable T=P+sum excluded mandatory deltas. Exclude source-explicit optional tips/service and conditional discounts; select the public non-member undiscounted quote. No coupon assumptions. If only a conditional discounted amount is visible, proxy/missing.

Apply only source-explicit rounding at its documented stage; otherwise retain unrounded arithmetic and label analytical total. No inferred tax rounding. Convert currency AFTER target total; hotel divides complete total by3; meal remains per one main. Aggregate normalized item amounts within venue then city.

Missing mandatory status,inclusion,exhaustiveness,unit,rate/base/order or unclear applicability means normalizationStatus=missing and normalizedAmount=null. Conflicting evidence creates dispute as defined; absence alone is uncertain. No percentage/fixed fee fallback.
feeNormalization.output: Coordinator produces {principal,chargeDeltas:[{id,amount,baseRefs}],normalizedTransactionTotal,normalizedMeasureAmount,normalizationStatus:complete|missing,normalizationReason,derivationHash}.
